decisions.reason: As a multi-model extension of the established laser portfolio, it embodies visible development and commercialization investment, and management can still justify any slower uptake as normal portfolio maturation while newer laser offerings broaden the segment.

This thermal inkjet printer remains close to the core coding business, had standalone web visibility, and fits the firm's application-specific solution logic, making withdrawal unlikely absent clear failure.
Although somewhat more specialized and potentially compared against other recent inkjet launches, it is still a close-to-core product backed by in-house R&D and thus likely to be defended for longer.

Because it was launched as a flagship, shown on the home page, and tied directly to the firm's stated direction toward broader industrial identification and traceability, escalation of commitment strongly favors continuation.
The compact laser cabin is a newly publicized addition on its own page within the established laser family, so management is likely to continue supporting it rather than reverse course quickly.

Despite being application-specific, the lubricant printing system builds on the firm's marking expertise and its trade-fair award gives management an external success signal that supports continued commitment.
